verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's docs list a first-party Mission Control Agent for investigating your environment and making supported changes, which suggests in-product AI analysis of the customer's own infrastructure data. The evidence is a single one-line mention, with no detail on what insights or suggestions it produces or where it surfaces in the Cloud Console. Billing insights and Grafana dashboards are conventional reporting, not AI-generated, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: documentation of the agent's insight and suggestion outputs, the data sources it analyzes, how it surfaces in the console UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Mission Control Agent and the Mission Control MCP server for investigating your environment and making supported changes.
